inspection.scope: All NONMATCHING target functions confirmed against actual ARM instructions; no compilation or target execution. Exact C release functions also read at committed source ref.

owned_design: Single concrete PeerPool is owned by the radio root and borrowed by AP, STA, P2P and RX consumers. No role-specific physical allocator.
Generational leases reject deferred completion after slot reuse. Retiring records remain reserved until concrete owner cancels timers/reorder queues, submits source removal, and consumes release.
PHY, HT, capability, signal quality, dBm and authorization are separate typed values; none are inferred from MAC or slot index.
Peer device0x17/0x18 serialization remains the StationIbss provider. PeerTransition is consumed by association/secondary engines, not a second serializer.

HardwarePeerPower is the actual ReceiveEvents-owned state embedded in each allocated canonical record. ReorderEngine retains canonical PeerLease keys and root teardown drains concrete packet publications before reuse.
limits: NetIndex roles0/1/2 and semantic state names are interface types, not proof supplied by function names.
